newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean basis offers edge higher.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean basis offers edge higher.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis values edged higher on Monday, regaining some lost ground after Friday's steep slide, dealers said.

They noted, however, that flat prices continued to weaken with CBOT soybean futures sharply lower to the 30-cent limit down. Demand remained sluggish with USDA reporting export inspections for the week to June 26 at just 5.91 million bushels, below trade forecasts of six to nine million.
Old crop soybean basis offers were around two cents higher following a 12-cent slide on Friday.
Corn and wheat basis values remained largely unchanged.
